description: Canadian directories, registries and marketing lists. Most Canadians are not in US people-search sites; start here.

brokers.name: Canada411 / YP.ca
brokers.notes: Name search by city works without a bot check. Removal is via their contact/help pages; only needed if the user actually appears. Not found for the pilot user.

brokers.name: 411.ca
brokers.notes: Not yet checked. Find the removal link in the site footer.

brokers.name: OpenCorporates
brokers.notes: Mirrors public company registries, including officer names and addresses. Not yet checked. Removal is limited by registry law.

brokers.name: National Do Not Call List (DNCL)
brokers.notes: Government registration for phone numbers. Needs only the phone number plus an email confirmation. Not submitted yet for the pilot user; user must approve since it is a registration, not a removal.

brokers.name: Registraire des entreprises du Quebec (REQ)
brokers.notes: Publishes the registered address of the corporation and its directors. Cannot be removed with an opt-out. The fix is a filing that changes the registered address (for example to a business address or PO box). It has cost and legal consequences, so always leave it to the user.
